crossRefs.note: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’s feet and wiped his feet with…
You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy…
He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
translations.bsb: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
translations.kjv: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
translations.asv: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron's beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
